description: A named, enableable set of rules that limit resource use across the object model.

Where a queue or host limits what it can give, a resource quota set limits what a *combination* may take - "this project may use 100 slots in total, wherever they are". The rules are tried in order and the first that matches decides.

attributes.name: name
description: The set's name, as used by `qconf -mrqs`.

attributes.name: description
description: Free text describing what the set is for.

attributes.name: enabled
description: Whether the set is applied. A disabled set stays configured but limits nothing.

attributes.name: rule
description: The rules (`RQR`), in the order they are tried.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
